confirmation.initialization: same released VOSR2 weights, independent optimizer for each seed
confirmation.recipes: top two fully evaluated recipe/mixture combinations
confirmation.report: individual seeds, mean/std, paired source-group intervals, and all final RealCE metrics

final_test_reporting.models: unmodified model, bicubic, all completed processing/mixture ablations, and all confirmation seeds
final_test_reporting.timing: After validation selection has been frozen

mixture_screen.processing: top two processing recipes under the precommitted validation ranking

model: original one-step VOSR2 1.4B, all 36 cross-attention blocks retained, no routers

selection_rule.primary: highest 1-NED on held-out AnyWord-ArT, never on RealCE test
selection_rule.scope: Best text-restoration recipe within the explicitly tested settings; retain image-quality tradeoffs and Pareto alternatives.

uncertainty.caveat: Scene-bootstrap intervals do not measure training-seed variance or remove selection bias.
uncertainty.unit: original image group; all overlapping crops resampled together
